title: MagicMaces
description: MagicMaces is a Minecraft plugin that adds three unique magical maces, each with a special right-click ability designed for fun but balanced combat.
body:
## Overview
**MagicMaces** is a Minecraft plugin that adds three magical maces, each with a unique right-click ability designed for fun and balanced combat.

## Magical Maces
- **Wind Mace** – Dash 6 blocks in the direction you are looking when you right-click.
- **Detonate Mace** – Launch nearby entities within 10 blocks outward, dealing 3 hearts of damage.
- **Void Mace** – Summon a black hole above your head that pulls nearby enemies in and slams them into the ground, dealing 6 hearts of damage.

## Balance
The normal Minecraft mace is allowed, but it cannot be enchanted to ensure fair competition on servers.
